plan.contrast: Vary only whole-window mean forward KL on registered ordinary-host preservation rows. CE over all supervised targets is unchanged. Coefficient one is predeclared, not selected from gradient norm ratios or outcomes.
plan.data_policy: Reuse the fixed English V22 training schedule only. The 512 new V23 world groups remain a separate later data factor. No Japanese, benchmark training, Toyota data or provider calls.
plan.development: Same exposed 40-row V22 development set, teacher-forced NLL before and after each arm. No quality threshold, checkpoint selection or release claim; new confirmation and OOD stay unopened.
plan.initialization: Both arms start at the pinned original Mistral, identical seed 47 and CPU FP32 masters. Neither V22 nor canary weights are inherited.
plan.scope: CPU then CUDA tiny qualification, fresh original-host target extraction, positive-P 2-update canary and separate-process step-2 replay, then off/on 32 updates each from the same base. Each role stops on its first failure. Failed records are immutable; no auto-retry, objective adjustment, world-bank expansion, generation, judge, weight export or Hub upload. Research-only data rights remain unreviewed for redistribution. Training completion is not preservation or quality success.
plan.storage_policy: Admission forecasts 3 x 28 GiB checkpoints plus 2.5 GiB targets and the unchanged 50 GiB free floor. Only one final save per training arm, no intermediate save or automatic deletion. The positive-P canary save remains for exact replay.
plan.teacher_policy: Pinned original Mistral BF16 eager eval; complete identical no-memory English train contexts; FP32 full-vocabulary log_softmax at every active causal target; same-weight train-mode forward sentinels on all 89 rows; no sampling or teacher-generated text.
